_doc: Hub ambient life (game/world/hub/hub_life.gd). lines: short barks shown in a bubble over an NPC, optionally gated by flags (if / if_not). pairs: two NPCs meet, trade lines, and part. stations: where each NPC wanders (x, z in hub metres, y is the floor).

mollusk.text: Slow down. The floor is not going anywhere.
Have you seen the new forklift in Bay Four?
Every second is borrowed. I am only admiring mine.
Aruun held the Span. I am letting myself be proud for exactly one minute.

bramvex.text: Third door on the left, if anyone asks. Nobody asks.
A good plan has a way out written into the first line.
Back from the Reaches in one piece. That is the only metric.

nerit.text: ...Could we dim the lights a little?
The pool lights are talking again. They are only saying hello.
Some things are meant to stay unlit.

zephyr.text: Nobody owes anybody anything until it is said aloud.
If you promise me something, say it slowly.
I heard about the Span. Very tidy promises, those.

nyxaris.text: Do not touch the thread. It is mid-sentence.
A pattern is a promise someone made to the cloth.
The stall pays fair. I checked the weave.

pharilux.text: Some doors are doing their job by staying shut.
A sealed thing is not a secret. It is a boundary.

solmara.text: The water is restless today. Somebody is worried.
Listen. The pool is a slow, low drum.
Your pulse is the loudest thing in this room.

scarlith.text: Everything has a price. Not everything is for sale.
That crate is mine. That one is also mine. That one is a gift, do not tell.
Salvage is a form of respect, if you do it right.

lines: Where is the exit from this conversation?
That was not a promise, was it.
I like it when the room is quiet.
Then I will be slow about it.
I will give you three coins for the thread.
Good. I wanted to be told so.
